## Right now

- 🛠️ **[PathMan](https://github.com/Napreth/PathMan)** — Building a Windows environment variable, PATH, and executable alias manager with a GUI, CLI, and shims. More than halfway there!
- 📱 **[Set for U](https://github.com/Napreth/Set-for-U)** — Shifting focus to app permissions for now; some features (such as eSIM settings) are blocked by AVD's emulation limitations.
- ✅ **[PSDirEnv](https://github.com/Napreth/PSDirEnv)** and **[RemoteComputerUse-for-Codex](https://github.com/Napreth/RemoteComputerUse-for-Codex)** — Both released. Give them a try!
- ☁️ **AVW** — Preparing the build infrastructure with **[Cloud-Compilation](https://github.com/Napreth/Cloud-Compilation)**.
- 🎬 **[Bilibili-style-PotPlayer](https://github.com/Napreth/Bilibili-style-PotPlayer)** — The core player behavior is ready; danmaku and settings still need work.
- 🔬 **Agent safety research** — Working through some tricky problems. QAQ
